column1: # Real English words with its last letter not yet typed, generated from the top 4,000 of the bundled pack so the
# set cannot be chosen to flatter a change. Fed to `suggest_eval --autocorrect`, which
# asks what the space bar commits rather than where the strip ranks a word.
# These two exist as a pair and only mean anything together: the mid-word set is what
# excluding completions from the corrections heap got wrong (12% right, 68% a different
# word), and the typo set is what it got right (100%) and what a fix must not cost.
